definitions.molecular: Native instantaneous total resolved 2*nu*S:S volume average; not qualified temporal fluctuation dissipation
definitions.work_units: m2/s3; total_svv_over_molecular is dimensionless; divergence_rms is 1/s
definitions.ranges: Arithmetic mean/min/max over exactly three instantaneous snapshots at each fixed slab/station, not a time integral or confidence interval
definitions.spatial_summary: Per-snapshot spatial min/max and slab-volume-weighted arithmetic mean. Mean of local SVV/molecular ratios differs from global_work's ratio of global means. Global divergence RMS uses the separate square-integral closure
definitions.station_work: Interpolate full x-slab averages by slab centers; domain edges use nearest center. Inlet values are not exact inlet-plane work
definitions.scales: Instantaneous-total-gradient surrogates mixing full-record temporal var(u) with a single total-strain snapshot; no qualified fluctuation epsilon or Table4 fidelity claim
definitions.decay: -U*delta_K/delta_x and -1.5*U*delta_var_u/delta_x are interval secants; the second invokes Eq.38 isotropy. Unclosed budgets omit pressure, transport, nonuniform-mean and time effects. No error bars added
definitions.hash_scope: Analysis, manifest, source session/table, receipt, native CSV/flow JSON and checkpoint Info.xml rehashed. Cache binding uses the historical analysis/cache receipt; NPZ and native history are not freshly rehashed by this collector. Large field partitions and executable retain recorded receipt hashes and were not reread

claim_limits: Three late snapshots are descriptive and do not qualify mean fluctuation dissipation or steady energy-budget closure

definitions.molecular: Native instantaneous total resolved 2*nu*S:S volume average; not qualified temporal fluctuation dissipation
definitions.work_units: m2/s3; total_svv_over_molecular is dimensionless; divergence_rms is 1/s
definitions.ranges: Arithmetic mean/min/max over exactly three instantaneous snapshots at each fixed slab/station, not a time integral or confidence interval
definitions.spatial_summary: Per-snapshot spatial min/max and slab-volume-weighted arithmetic mean. Mean of local SVV/molecular ratios differs from global_work's ratio of global means. Global divergence RMS uses the separate square-integral closure
definitions.station_work: Interpolate full x-slab averages by slab centers; domain edges use nearest center. Inlet values are not exact inlet-plane work
definitions.scales: Instantaneous-total-gradient surrogates mixing full-record temporal var(u) with a single total-strain snapshot; no qualified fluctuation epsilon or Table4 fidelity claim
definitions.decay: -U*delta_K/delta_x and -1.5*U*delta_var_u/delta_x are interval secants; the second invokes Eq.38 isotropy. Unclosed budgets omit pressure, transport, nonuniform-mean and time effects. No error bars added
definitions.hash_scope: Analysis, manifest, source session/table, receipt, native CSV/flow JSON and checkpoint Info.xml rehashed. Cache binding uses the historical analysis/cache receipt; NPZ and native history are not freshly rehashed by this collector. Large field partitions and executable retain recorded receipt hashes and were not reread

physics.length_note: L is the native von Karman shape parameter, distinct from longitudinal integral scale Lf
physics.uncut_dissipation_note: For A>0 the uncut k^(-5/3) tail has finite K and divergent integral k^2*E dk/dissipation; A=0 is identically zero
physics.retained_band_note: Common explicit cutoff and cos^2 energy taper regularize the retained band; amplitude is preserved with no retained-band renormalization

svv.note: Separate xy/z solver properties; DG xy coefficient scales with native h/p and prescribed constant speed. ExpKernel xy coefficient is direct viscosity, not DG scaling.

time.stress_snapshot_note: Cumulative post-start central moments. At positive record-start, first snapshot has one sample/zero variance. Native fixed-frequency output may add intermediate snapshots and a duplicate final snapshot.

synthesis.mode_estimate_note: Sphere-volume estimate only; not the retained discrete mode count

window.anti_aliasing: No postprocessing antialias filter imposed; sampling/aliasing qualification remains necessary.

definitions.molecular: Native instantaneous total resolved 2*nu*S:S volume average; not qualified temporal fluctuation dissipation
definitions.work_units: m2/s3; total_svv_over_molecular is dimensionless; divergence_rms is 1/s
definitions.ranges: Arithmetic mean/min/max over exactly three instantaneous snapshots at each fixed slab/station, not a time integral or confidence interval
definitions.spatial_summary: Per-snapshot spatial min/max and slab-volume-weighted arithmetic mean. Mean of local SVV/molecular ratios differs from global_work's ratio of global means. Global divergence RMS uses the separate square-integral closure
definitions.station_work: Interpolate full x-slab averages by slab centers; domain edges use nearest center. Inlet values are not exact inlet-plane work
definitions.scales: Instantaneous-total-gradient surrogates mixing full-record temporal var(u) with a single total-strain snapshot; no qualified fluctuation epsilon or Table4 fidelity claim
definitions.decay: -U*delta_K/delta_x and -1.5*U*delta_var_u/delta_x are interval secants; the second invokes Eq.38 isotropy. Unclosed budgets omit pressure, transport, nonuniform-mean and time effects. No error bars added
definitions.hash_scope: Analysis, manifest, source session/table, receipt, native CSV/flow JSON and checkpoint Info.xml rehashed. Cache binding uses the historical analysis/cache receipt; NPZ and native history are not freshly rehashed by this collector. Large field partitions and executable retain recorded receipt hashes and were not reread

claim_limits: Three late snapshots are descriptive and do not qualify mean fluctuation dissipation or steady energy-budget closure
Published Table4 values are copied only from the existing analysis for context; no fitting or additional experimental source was loaded
Zero molecular work makes its ratio/scales unavailable; incomplete defined ranges remain null rather than dropping snapshots

history_validation.finite_scope: All native ASCII frames including pressure and all NPZ velocities were validated by the bound production analyzer. Final review checks receipts/bindings without re-reading large histories/NPZ.
